paper_id: Chen et al. - 2007 - Difficulty-aware Hybrid Search in Peer-to-Peer Networks
title: Difficulty-aware Hybrid Search in Peer-to-Peer Networks
motivation: 混合P2P搜索中，现有方法假设"项目多=节点多"，但用户偏好存储相似项目，导致该假设失效。
problem_framing: 如何准确估计有多少个对等节点能够回答给定查询，以选择泛洪或DHT搜索策略。
key_insight: "Many items ≠ many peers"——由于兴趣局部性，同一查询的相关项目可能集中在少数节点；需用IPF和apTF加权来估计实际覆盖的节点数。
method_signature: 基于apTF×IPF权重和SVM分类器的查询难度感知混合搜索协议QRank。
evaluation_criteria: 召回率、响应延迟、通信开销、搜索效率(召回/开销)、综合效用。
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: P2P查询极短导致f_{q,t}恒为1，传统TF失效；动态网络下统计精度受节点在线时间影响。
evidence_for_taste: estimating the number of peers that can answer a question
cannot distinguish whether items distributed in many peers or in a few peers
terms more frequently used in a query are likely important
different from queries in traditional information retrieval application, P2P queries are typically short
the accuracy of QRank is influenced by the uptime of a peer
thinking_moves: 从工程失效反推底层假设错误——"many items → many peers"假设被兴趣局部性否定
将P2P搜索选择问题类比为信息检索中的词权重问题
针对P2P查询极短的特点改造TF公式，引入apTF
用SVM而非简单阈值来处理多维决策空间(ϖ_q, σ_q)
